captions.detailed: This 3D model is a dual-sided, C-shaped utility clip designed for holding cylindrical objects or cables. On one end, a large, elongated elliptical clamp curves inward, leaving a wide front opening. On the opposite end, a smaller, circular C-clip faces outward to snap onto a secondary support. The entire clip has a uniform height and a consistent wall thickness, forming a rigid yet flexible single-piece plastic fastener.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric dual-sided C-clip in OpenSCAD. The design should feature an elongated top jaw and bottom jaw on one side separated by a customizable gap, and a circular snap-clip on the opposing side, with parameters to adjust the bend radius, height, wall thickness, and jaw gap.
captions.factory: The script defines the `TopJaw` and `BottomJaw` modules by scaling a cylinder along the y-axis, subtracting a smaller concentric cylinder to establish the wall thickness, and using a subtracted cube to cut away half of the shape. In the main `clip` module, these jaws are translated along the y-axis by half the `Gap` parameter to form the elongated clamp. A circular clip is created on the opposite side using a cylinder with a subtracted inner cylinder and a cube to cut open the front jaw, all unified into a single printable part.
